narrative: The poem is off the shelf for the first time since March, open under the grey light. Beside it the commonplace, headed Verona, is open at a line you left blank in Lent. The pen is not on that line. Gib is asleep on the Golding, off to the side, and not on either page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the blank and left it open.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Slept on the Golding and was not moved.

entities.name: Brooke's Romeus and Juliet
